candidate.answerReason: Each tangent-radius triangle has hypotenuse 5 and one leg 3, so the other leg is 4. Their areas sum to 2 × (3 × 4/2) = 12.

methods.label: Split into two right triangles
methods.explanation: \(\angle PAO=90^\circ\), so \(PA=\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4\). The area of \(\triangle PAO\) is \(3\times4/2=6\), and the area of quadrilateral \(PAOB\) is \(2\times6=12\).
methods.levelReason: Uses tangent-radius perpendicularity, the Pythagorean theorem, and elementary triangle-area addition.
